hero.headline: Health First. Community Always.
hero.sub: Where world-class personal training meets a supportive community built around clean living, real connection, and lifelong wellness.

mission.p1: The food industry profits from making you sick. Social media profits from your attention. Gaming companies fire the people who made their best games. Healthcare safety nets are disappearing.
mission.p2: SwanStudios exists because we believe you deserve better. A platform that puts your health first, remembers your journey, supports your trainer, celebrates your creativity, and never sells you out.
mission.p3: We're not here to extract value from you. We're here to help you build it — for yourself, and for the people around you.
mission.closing: Built by a trainer. Built with the community. Powered by all of us.
